_meta.name: Jay design tokens
_meta.basis: Extracted from the Just Move In Figma library. Page names preserved: 1. Primitives, 2. Dimensions, 3. shadcn/ui colors, 4. shadcn/ui radius, 5. Typography, 6. JMI Colours.
changes: Type scale floor raised from 12px to 14px. GOV.UK removed 14 and below from its scale citing British Dyslexia Association guidance. 14px is metadata only; anything a mover reads to act is 16px or larger.
Added colour.pending. Neither success nor failure. Used for tasks that were sent to a destination that provides no confirmation mechanism.
Removed red from general use. Genuine failures use warning plus explicit copy. Red on a council notification reads as catastrophe to an anxious mover.
All machine-derived numerals render with lining tabular figures.

Prototype renders in Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono as freely available stand-ins; production targets Degular Display and Geist Mono per the JMI Figma. The human/machine split is the invariant, not the specific faces.

ring.comment: Ring colour used for focus state

primary.comment: Primary colour for <Button />. JMI brand violet

success.comment: Confirmed by the destination. Requires a stored receipt

pending.comment: LOAD BEARING. Sent, no receipt available. Must not be collapsed into success or destructive in code review

destructive.comment: Reserved. Not used in the mover-facing flow

display.comment: Licensed brand face. Figtree is the fallback so the prototype runs without the licence

mono.comment: Every machine-derived value: states, prices, percentages, timestamps, meter readings

base.comment: Minimum for anything read to make a decision
